falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern anticipated a higher low formation; a break below 4,800 would violate the structural support expected in this pattern and invalidate the bottoming thesis

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for two consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 39 suggests controlled volatility; sustained VIX above 35 indicates panic-driven selling rather than orderly bottoming, contradicting the pattern's implied volatility regime

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury yield spread inverts further below -50 basis points
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The pattern match assumes improving financial conditions; deeper inversion signals accelerating recession risk that would override the technical bottom formation and invalidate the macro recovery signal

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
